The Story of AI

A Brief History

From Alan Turing's visionary questions to the generative AI revolution — every milestone in this journey reshaped what it means to be human.

1950

The Birth of AI

Alan Turing poses the question: 'Can machines think?' The journey begins at Bletchley Park.

1956

The Dartmouth Conference

John McCarthy coins the term 'Artificial Intelligence' and the field is officially born.

1967

First Expert Systems

DENDRAL becomes the first expert system, analyzing chemical structures with AI.

1997

Deep Blue Beats Kasparov

IBM's Deep Blue defeats world chess champion Garry Kasparov — a historic moment.

2012

The Deep Learning Revolution

AlexNet wins ImageNet by a landslide. The world takes notice of neural networks.

2017

The Transformer Era

Google introduces 'Attention Is All You Need' — the foundation for ChatGPT and beyond.

2023

The Generative AI Explosion

ChatGPT, DALL-E, and Midjourney transform how we create, think, and interact.

The Future is Now

We're living in the most exciting era of AI development. Every day brings breakthroughs that were unimaginable just a few years ago. What will you create?
